subject: Acme Payments — VPC/private deployment follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@acmepayments.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + next steps (VPC/private deployment)

Hi Samir / Maria —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Needs & constraints you called out:
- PCI scope: sensitive payment data will stay in Acme's environment (VPC/on-prem preferred).
- Latency target: ~<150ms 95p for payment verification flows.
- Expected pilot traffic: ~50k inference requests/day (burst to 200k over peak).
- Key success criteria: latency SLA, audit logs, and predictable cost.

2) Redwood proposal (high level)
- Private deployment (VPC) with customer-managed networking and optional on-prem package.
- Dedicated capacity to meet latency SLOs; can start with a reserved pilot cluster and scale.
- We will provide SOC2 artifacts, audit log delivery, and KMS integrations for key management.

3) Next steps
- I attached our VPC & on-prem overview (20260610-redwood-vpc-overview.pdf) and a short template to capture architecture/requirements (acme_requirements.xlsx).
- Can we schedule a technical sync with your infra/security lead next week? I suggested Tue/Wed morning PT — Jonas (cc) would join to discuss networking and SSO requirements.
- If you want ballpark numbers for cost/SOW ahead of the sync, tell me the pilot duration and an approximate QPS profile and I’ll share a rough estimate.

If anything in the recap is off, let me know. Otherwise I’ll follow up with proposed times for the technical call.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132

Attachments: 20260610-redwood-vpc-overview.pdf (application/pdf), acme_requirements.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next steps (VPC/private deployment)

Hi Samir / Maria —

Just wanted to bump this in case it got buried. Would love to get your preference on timing for the technical sync and whether a VPC/private route is likely to be the right path for the pilot. If timeline is flexible, we can also scope a hosted → private migration plan that reduces initial cost and risk.

Quick options for next week: Tue 10–11am PT, Wed 9–10am PT, or I can send a calendar poll for other times.

Also happy to share a short Ballpark SOW/estimate if that would help with internal prioritization — what pilot duration should I assume (4–8 weeks is common)?

Thanks —
Marissa

- Maria (our CTO) is OOO this week and will drive infra/security decisions when she returns next Tue.
- Can you share a very rough SOW/estimate and an outline of the types of connectivity options you support (AWS VPC peering, PrivateLink, on-prem VPN)? That will help us set internal expectations.

Jonas — forwarding Samir's note. He asked for a very short SOW/estimate and a summary of connectivity options (VPC peering, PrivateLink, on‑prem VPN). Can you draft a 1‑pager we can send to Samir early next week?

Goals for the one‑pager:
- High level SOW for a 6‑week pilot (objectives, deliverables, assumptions).
- Ballpark cost range for reserved pilot cluster and a note on scaling to production.
- Network connectivity options we support and a short list of questions for Acme's infra team (subnets, firewall, NAT, proxy).

If you want, I can take the first pass and you can add technical details. Need this before Tue when Maria returns.

Thanks —
